options.text: Water is a worse conductor, so the heat stayed at the bottom.
options.feedback: Kabir's card: "Water is a bad conductor, everyone knows."

options.text: Water needs more energy than oil to raise its temperature by one degree. It soaks up energy without warming as much.
The flame under the water was smaller.
options.feedback: Kabir's card: "Ajji's burners are not equal."

image.alt: Two cups receiving identical streams of heat from below, the oil cup's thermometer rising twice as far as the water cup's.
